description: Architected a dual-mode RAG system for clinical decision support. Engineered a semantic search pipeline using Sentence Transformers and FAISS. Integrated Whisper AI for voice-based clinical guidance and deployed on DigitalOcean with RBAC.

Engaged in critical analysis of clinical NLP and medical imaging papers. Collaborating within focus groups to identify open research questions and design experimental protocols for computer vision projects.
Built a full-stack vendor guide app (Next.js, PostgreSQL) used by 260+ attendees. Implemented a TF-IDF recommendation engine and Gemini-powered summaries, improving user click-through rates by 7%.
Built a governance-compliant pipeline to analyze Play Store reviews. Contributed to an AI-powered Microsoft Teams chatbot enabling 2,000+ staff to instantly access process information.
Automated deployment of 30+ AWS resources using Terraform, reducing manual setup by 75%. Containerized Node.js microservices with Docker and deployed to AKS.
Led a team to ship real-time music/chess rooms using WebRTC, boosting engagement by 20%. Improved backend performance by 50% through caching and refactoring.
